description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers scoring roadmaps, PR reviews, ADRs, and tickets for completeness (risk, tests, migration, AC, DoR). Should-not covers near-miss neighbours: code-quality review (judge-code-quality), bug hunting (judge-bug-hunter), test-file coverage (judge-test-coverage), security audit (judge-security-auditor), and creating an ADR from scratch (adr-create).

queries.q: score this roadmap for completeness — does it cover risk, tests, and migration?
does this PR review have enough evidence? is each finding traceable to a diff line?
check if this ticket meets DoR — are the acceptance criteria verifiable?
is this ADR complete? does it name alternatives and state consequences?
what dimensions are missing from this roadmap — risk, maintainability, migration?
review the naming and DRY violations in this diff
find the bugs introduced by this change
does this PR add enough test coverage for the new behaviour?
are there security issues in this authentication middleware?
create an ADR for switching from REST to GraphQL
